caption: A toy train runs along a track, hits a wooden block lying across the rails, and stops.

sa.check: A toy train runs along a track.
A wooden block lies across the rails in its path and the train reaches it.
The train stops at the block.
The block lies across the rails rather than beside them.
The train runs first and the stop at the block follows.

pc.expect: The train is stopped where it meets the block, and the block may be shoved along a little.
pc.fail: The train stops before it reaches the block; or it runs over the block and carries on unaffected; or the block flies away before the train touches it.

pc.expect: The train is checked at the block: it halts there or comes off the rails, rather than carrying on at its old speed.
pc.fail: The train carries on at the same speed after meeting the block; or it is thrown back up the track quicker than it came; or it stops and then sets off again on its own.

pc.expect: The train, the block and the rails stay solid and separate.
pc.fail: The train passes through the block; or the block passes through the rails; or a wheel passes through the track.

pc.expect: The train and the wooden block stay rigid at the contact, the block sliding or tipping rather than folding.
pc.fail: The block bends or squashes where the train hits it; or the train's body crumples; or the block flows out of the way like a liquid.

pc.expect: One train and one block are there throughout.
pc.fail: The block vanishes as the train reaches it; or a second block appears on the rails; or a carriage disappears from the train.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The train's livery, the block and the track stay the same.
pc.fail: The train changes colour at the stop; or the block changes size or colour between frames; or the track's layout changes.
